case_metadata.case_caption: Alex Rivera v. Jordan Blake, concerning ownership of Brightline Ventures, Inc. and alleged embezzlement of company funds
case_metadata.summary: Plaintiff Alex Rivera claims ownership of Brightline Ventures, Inc., which Defendant Jordan Blake incorporated on Rivera's behalf. After incorporation, Blake allegedly gained access to company funds and embezzled money. Rivera seeks documents to establish his ownership and Blake's misappropriation.

causes_of_action.name: Declaratory Judgment of Ownership
elements: Defendant incorporated company on Plaintiff's behalf

causes_of_action.name: Embezzlement / Misappropriation of Company Funds
elements: Defendant had access to company funds

case_metadata.extraction_notes: Complaint is sparse; causes of action are inferred from the narrative. Placeholder mapping provided in the complaint is used to replace [COMPANY NAME], [PERSON A], and [PERSON B] with real names.
